decision: Selected the US Census Bureau geocoder point for 1726 Farmer Road, Conyers, GA 30012, the facility address that Georgia EPD's public advisory PA1026-4a gives for 'DCB Atlanta East, LLC' (air application 29932), as the campus locator. No official parcel geometry was reachable: www.rockdalecountyga.gov is treated as blocked after the us-southeast-p1 HTTP 503/WAF incident, and the qPublic/Beacon assessor front ends were not used (interactive terms and bot challenge). ArcGIS Online feature hosts answer robots.txt with HTTP 403.
conversion: Geocoder output in NAD83 geographic coordinates used as WGS84 without transformation (sub-metre difference at this scale); rounded to 7 decimals.
identity_bridge: Georgia EPD Air Protection Branch public advisory PA1026-4a (PDF created 28 October 2026; listed on EPD's advisories page as 28 October 2026) gives, under 'Synthetic Minor Permits and Amendments', ROCKDALE COUNTY: Facility Name 'DCB Atlanta East, LLC', Application No 29932, Facility Address '1726 Farmer Road, Conyers, 30012', EPD Notice Type 'Proposed Permit', Description of Operation 'Data Processing, Hosting, and Relating Services', Reason for Application 'Construction and operation of ninety-seven (97) diesel-fired emergency generators sized at 3.0-MW each', comment period expiring 30 November 2026.

DC BLOX's Atlanta East Hyperscale Data Center Campus page (article:modified_time 19 October 2026; the same version archived by the Internet Archive on 26 October 2026) gives the campus location as '1726 Farmer Road, Conyers, Georgia 30012' in Rockdale County, bridging the EPD permittee name 'DCB Atlanta East, LLC' to DC BLOX's Atlanta East campus.

The Census geocoder matches the address (1726 FARMER RD NW, CONYERS, GA, 30012) on TIGER/Line edge 23740361 (left side, address range 1700-1998) in Rockdale County (13247), Conyers CCD, the county the EPD advisory names. The geocoder adds the street suffix direction 'NW', which EPD and DC BLOX omit; house number, street, city and ZIP agree.
not_used: No map service, map viewport, embedded map widget, short link, directory coordinate, OpenStreetMap service, PeeringDB record, city centre or county centroid was used. Only the address text of the DC BLOX page was used; no coordinates or map widget from it.
nearby_records_within_2km: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping coordinate, pending queue addition, locator correction or claim by another fragment lies within 2 km. The nearest Atlas record is TADG ATL02 Ellenwood (Clayton County), 24.6 km away.
precision_note: The point is the geocoder's interpolated position for the address along the street segment, not the facility parcel, a building or a surveyed boundary; the facility extent and its offset from the street are unknown.
